name: Creatureliness Operator Package
description: Core operators for section-level prompt experimentation and downstream artifact prompts.

operators.label: Summarize Core Claim
operators.instruction: Compress the section into a high-signal thesis with no metaphoric drift.
operators.template: Summarize section {{section_id}} into 3-5 sentences: core claim, stakes, and operational implication.

operators.label: Extract Operational Instructions
operators.instruction: Convert claims into actionable design instructions.
operators.template: From section {{section_id}}, extract concrete instructions with conditions and failure modes.

operators.label: Counterargument Pressure Test
operators.instruction: Stress the section with strongest opposing interpretation.
operators.template: Construct the strongest counterargument to section {{section_id}}, then rebut it with evidence from the section.

operators.label: Ontology Normalization
operators.instruction: Reduce language to primitive entities, relations, and constraints.
operators.template: Normalize section {{section_id}} into primitives: entities, relations, constraints, and invariants.

operators.label: Video Prompt Export
operators.instruction: Generate a production-grade master AI video prompt.
operators.template: Generate one master AI video prompt from section {{section_id}} with scene beats, camera language, color, and timing.

operators.label: Single-File HTML Export
operators.instruction: Generate a fully functional single-file HTML/CSS/JS animation prompt.
operators.template: Generate one prompt that yields a complete single-file HTML/CSS/JS animation from section {{section_id}}.

operators.label: Evidence Gap Audit
operators.instruction: Locate unsupported claims and specify required evidence.
operators.template: Audit section {{section_id}} for unsupported claims; list missing evidence and suggested tests.

operators.label: Implementation Plan
operators.instruction: Translate section into a pragmatic build plan.
operators.template: Turn section {{section_id}} into a phased implementation plan with milestones and acceptance criteria.
